subject: Post-call: model routing, retrieval config & reranker options (HelionTech pilot)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call: model routing, retrieval config & reranker options (HelionTech pilot)

Hi Samantha / Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our side so we can move to a scoped pilot: 

Summary of needs we heard
- Primary goal: accurate, auditable answers from a mixed set of internal docs (policy PDFs, KB articles, ticket threads).
- SLAs: sub-600ms median answer time for conversational flow; occasional high-accuracy queries can tolerate more latency.
- Risk: lowering hallucination is top priority for product-search and compliance workflows.

High-level pilot proposal (recommended approach)
1) Retrieval topology: hybrid dense + BM25 (candidate set size = 100) with two retriever variants to compare:
   - Variant A: dense-first (FAISS HNSW) then BM25 backfill
   - Variant B: BM25-focused candidate set then dense rerank
2) Reranker: test two profiles 
   - Profile 1: lightweight cross-encoder reranker (latency-optimized) for interactive flows
   - Profile 2: pairwise cross-encoder (higher compute) for compliance-critical responses
3) Model routing for generation: route typical conversational requests to a quantized 7B model for cost/latency, but fallback to a 13B fp16 model for complex, high-accuracy questions. We will provide throughput numbers for both.
4) Benchmarks & evals: we propose the following metrics for the pilot: grounding precision, hallucination rate (oracle-backed), answer latency P50/P95, and token cost per query. We'll run an initial probe of ~250 queries drawn from your sample prompt set.

Deliverables & timeline
- Deliver by EOD next Wed: suggested retrieval + reranker configs, sample prompt set (we'll attach), and an initial eval run (CSV) showing baseline grounding precision.
- Kickoff pilot week of Mar 20 (tentative) — 2-week technical run + 1-week review.

Immediate asks from HelionTech
- Confirm the three sample use-case buckets (search, ticket summarization, regulatory lookup).
- Provide a security contact for the SOC/contract path so we can kick off any required questionnaires in parallel.

Ben and Jasmine, I’m copying you for the config/ops details below. Samantha/Tom — please reply with procurement contact and whether the timeline works.

Thanks,
--
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks Soojin — adding the ops/engineering specifics we discussed. Attaching quick eval CSV + prompt set (see attachments).

Technical notes / concrete configs
- Retriever candidates: run with candidate_set_k=100, use FAISS IVF-PQ for dense index (embedding dim 1536). For smaller documents (<=512 tokens) we’ll store chunked vectors at 256 token stride.
- BM25: tuned with k1=1.2, b=0.65 for the mixed-document corpus we saw.
- Reranker selection: we recommend trying the ‘pairwise-contrast’ profile and a latency-optimized ‘mono-cross’ profile. Pairwise improves grounding recall on factual Qs by ~6-9% at the cost of ~2.5x CPU/GPU usage.
- Caching & batching: suggest prefix KV caching on session-level queries and batching window of 25ms to balance latency and cost.
- Eval probes: run 250 queries split 60/40 between short factual lookups and longer multi-paragraph context questions. Measure:
   * grounding_precision = fraction of responses that cite a supporting doc span correctly
   * hallucination_rate = fraction of responses with unsupported assertions (evaluated by a small human-in-the-loop set)
   * latency_p50/p95 and tokens_per_query

Quick command snippets we’ll use in pilot (ops)
- build-index --source s3://helion-dump --chunk-size 512 --stride 256 --method faiss-ivf-pq
- run-eval --prompts prompt_set_v1.txt --retrievers dense,bm25 --rerankers mono-cross,pairwise-contrast --out helion_eval_results_v1.csv

Attachments included: helion_eval_results_v1.csv (baseline), prompt_set_v1.txt, reranker_profiles.yaml
